errors.says: The normalized butterfly H_0 is applied to the selected bit in each of d address chunks.
errors.paper: The layer acts on D consecutive K-bit chunks with 1<=D<=d and K=floor(d^c) (lines 1767-1772, 2614, 2651); d is the bound on the number of chunks, and transform rounds use D<=d-1.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to O(n(lg n)^{1-κ}): radix digits, the CRT map, Gaussian resampling with R and Q retained, the chirp and twisted ring convolution over synthetic transforms, whose layouts and layers rest on the two fixed networks (bank exchange, frames, labels, rank budget s<Wm, τ=1-2^{-50}, matrix shear, the V/W recurrences), then exact recovery and the margin table. It thins out in the label construction (no A, B, P, Q or gate-label table, so comparability of labels is asserted), in the bit endpoint identity (stated, not proved), in the triangular factorization (stated only), and in the network and fixed parameters (h=100, N, m=h^3 and c, λ, λ', δ are never given).

steps.note: The fixed linear network on three-element subsets, its eight-row restoring schedule, and the three-stage exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring every scratch wire are stated with their mechanism. The parameters h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never given explicitly; m appears only as the label dimension.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise linear gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and only edge changes cost anything: all present.

Nondegenerate labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m from orthogonal neighbouring triple lines, comparable labels on every edge, and only the central 3->4 edges decreasing by h. The concrete gate labels (eq:motif-labels) are not given.
P_V-P_U is the identity on V∩U^perp with rank dim V - dim U; the N source edges 2P_{U_a} have rank one with zero dimension change.
Source sums N, sink sums Wm-N, telescoping at gates to Wm-2N, L=Ich, the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and hence s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 below 1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0), so s<Wm.

S5.9.3 states the endpoint condition M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m and draws the consequence that every role, scratch roles included, receives H<-H+D. Why the identity holds (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m) is not shown.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, the shear done with exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each edge a recursive shear, and s recursive calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} from η>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^τ) via the geometric sum.

central.summary: All nine steps of the central saving are reconstructed in their order and role: network, frames, labels, rank = dimension change, budget, strict deficit, endpoint shear, edges as recursive interchanges, and the V/W recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. The weak points are omissions inside steps: the network sizes h=100, N and m=h^3, the explicit gate labels, and the proof of the endpoint identity.
